eyebrow.zh: 本地 · 不上云 · 来源级联

headline.zh:
记下的每条事实都带着来源
来源一改，旧事实立刻标失效
headline.en:
Every fact you note keeps its source
when the source edits, the stale fact flags itself

sub.zh: 跨微信公众号、钉钉、WPS、浏览器读到的内容，本地 Qwen 抽取事实并打上来源指纹——不截图、不上云、来源变就级联失效。
sub.en: Read across WeChat articles, DingTalk docs, WPS, and the browser; a local Qwen extracts facts and tags each by source — no screenshots, no cloud, cascade-flagging the moment a source mutates.

title.en: Source memory that never leaves your Mac

body.zh: 原始屏幕文本经本地 Ollama Qwen3 处理，不调云端 API；全开源可审计，数据从头到尾留在你设备里。
body.en: Raw screen text is processed by a local Ollama Qwen3 — no cloud API calls; fully open-source and auditable, your data stays on your device end to end.

title.en: Every fact carries a source fingerprint

body.zh: 记下一条数字时，溯记同时记下它来自哪篇公众号、哪份钉钉文档；一条命令回溯到原始出处。
body.en: When you note a number, SuJi also records which WeChat article or DingTalk doc it came from; one command traces it back to the origin.

title.en: When a source edits, stale facts cascade-flag

body.zh: 公众号文章被编辑或钉钉文档更新时，派生自旧内容的事实自动标失效，并附上新旧 diff——你不会再引用过时的数字。
body.en: When a WeChat article is edited or a DingTalk doc updated, facts derived from the old content auto-flag as stale with a before/after diff — you never cite an outdated number again.

title.en: Ambient capture from the menu bar

body.zh: 读取聚焦窗口的纯文本，无截图、无 OCR，后台运行不干扰你阅读。
body.en: Reads the focused window's plain text via macOS Accessibility — no screenshots, no OCR, runs in the background without interrupting your reading.

headline.zh: 给读过的每个数字一个可追溯的家
headline.en: Give every number you've read a traceable home

sub.zh: 本地 Qwen · 来源指纹 · 级联失效 — macOS 开源，即装即用。
sub.en: Local Qwen · source fingerprint · cascade-flagging — open-source on macOS, install and go.

tag.zh: MIT 开源 · 数据不出设备
tag.en: MIT open-source · data never leaves your device
